text:
alex: Quick heads-up 1: planning a soft-spin for the llm-route split flag in us-central at 03:30 UTC. Goal: validate routing + cost regressions before wider rollout.

 tanya: Outline?

 alex: short plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50%. Holds 4m, 8m, 12m between steps. Automatic rollback triggers on p95>220ms or errors>1.5%. We'll seed cohorts with header `X-Split-Seed` to keep samples consistent.

 sourav: Recommend pin backend model to `llm-serve@r3-2026` for cohort. Also add `llm.route.fallback=stable` so requests can failover.

 alex: agreed, pinning model and setting fallback. Rollout payload below.

 alex: ```json
{"policy":"staged","steps":[{"pct":1,"hold":"4m"},{"pct":5,"hold":"8m"},{"pct":20,"hold":"12m"},{"pct":50,"hold":"15m"}],"pin":"llm-serve@r3-2026","rollback_on":["p95>220","err_rate>1.5"]}
```

 tanya: Ops please run a short KV preload 10m prior to step-1 to warm embeddings cache (reduce cold token variance). Also preflight perf tests against prod-like qps.

 ops-bot: Scheduled `embed-preload/llmroute-r3` at 2026-04-05T03:20:00Z. Will post completion. Preflight perf: queued.

 deploy-bot: Queued rollout `ffctl roll llm-route-split --env=us-central --payload=inline` JobID: roll-45291 ETA 2026-04-05T03:30:00Z. Will annotate release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/llmroute-2026-04-05

 sourav: Add metric snapshots: baseline p95, p50, error rate, cost-per-req. Tanya will capture traces on the first two steps.

 tanya: I'll take traces and enable trace-sampling=1% for the cohort. Posting dashboard in thread once ready.

 alex: On auto-backoff: deploy-bot will step down to previous healthy step + add 10m cooldown. If that fails twice, it will escalate to #eng-oncall and mark the rollout `manual-review`.

 deploy-bot: Auto-backoff policy enabled. If escalation occurs, will open incident stub and ping oncall. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ff-rollout-backoff

 oncall-bot: Oncall rota: will be paged on escalation. Current oncall: sourav.

 sourav: I'll be ready. If manual rollback needed, I will execute `ffctl rollback llm-route-split --to=0%` and coordinate a postmortem.

 tanya: Small note: enable `request-metrics: true` header so we can attribute cost changes to cohort.

 alex: Good. Final checklist: pin model `llm-serve@r3-2026`, set rollout payload, schedule embed-preload, enable headers/traces, set alert thresholds, confirm oncall. Start in ~25m.

 tanya: SGTM. I'll post heartbeat and metric snapshots every holdpoint.

 sourav: tagging @alex for release notes blurb. I'll attach trace collection instructions after rollout.

 alex: Thanks team. If any unusual patterns, trigger manual rollback early and notify product.
